quests.title: Quest Js Ignition Q1 Console And Functions
quests.briefing_md:
# Console and Functions

JavaScript is the language of the web. Understanding how to output data and encapsulate logic into functions is the first step toward mastery.

### Your Objective
1. Write a function `greet` that takes a name and logs `"Hello, [name]!"` to the console.
2. Call the function with your name.

quests.title: Quest Js Arrays Q2 Map Filter Reduce
quests.briefing_md:
# Functional Array Methods

Modern JavaScript favors functional programming patterns for data transformation. `map`, `filter`, and `reduce` are essential tools in your kit.

### Your Objective
Given an array of numbers, use `filter` to keep only the even numbers, and then use `map` to double them.
